blueprints.action: 手持画笔，站在大画布前回头看向门口。
blueprints.promptProse: Mashiro stands beside a tall canvas in her paint-marked white shirt and navy trousers. Her right hand holds one plain wooden paintbrush near its ferrule; the single blue bristle tip touches a small blue stroke on the canvas, while the dry wooden handle extends backward from her hand. She looks back toward the doorway with calm pale orange eyes. Afternoon light crosses her long cream-blonde hair, the canvas grain and neatly placed paint tubes.

blueprints.title: 椎名真白 · 年轮蛋糕的仪式感
blueprints.description: 矮桌前，她把年轮蛋糕端端正正摆在盘子中央，双手扶膝盯着它看了足足十秒才下叉；咬下第一口时眼睛几不可察地弯了一下，是她最大的表情幅度。

blueprints.promptProse: Kneeling at a low table, Mashiro studies a neatly centered slice of baumkuchen with both hands resting on her knees. A small fork waits beside the plate; her orange eyes soften almost imperceptibly at the prospect of the first bite. Her cream sweater and loose trousers fold naturally at the knees, with quiet afternoon light crossing the tatami and ceramic plate.

blueprints.title: 椎名真白 · 便利店甜点柜前
blueprints.description: 她贴在便利店甜点柜玻璃前，视线锁定年轮蛋糕，手指在玻璃上留下小小的雾气；被问「要买吗」时只是持续点头，动作像等待投喂的猫。
blueprints.action: 指尖轻触玻璃，专注看着柜中的年轮蛋糕。
blueprints.promptProse: At a convenience-store dessert cabinet, Mashiro fixes her orange eyes on a wrapped baumkuchen. A fingertip touches a faint patch of mist on the glass while she gives a tiny determined nod. Her red school ribbon and navy blazer remain tidy against the chilled display; the close three-quarter view catches the cake reflection and her patient, catlike concentration.

blueprints.title: 椎名真白 · 画室里的赭色指印
blueprints.description: 画室窗边，真白穿燕麦色亚麻工作罩衫，坐在画架前用布擦掉手指上的赭色颜料。她发现纸角留下一个小指印，专注地歪头端详，随后换起画笔把它接成一片叶子。
blueprints.action: 擦去指上颜料，把纸角的意外指印补成一片叶子。
blueprints.promptProse: Mashiro Shiina discovers an ochre fingerprint at the corner of her sketch and studies it with a quiet tilt of the head. An oatmeal linen smock protects the charcoal dress beneath it. Seated beside the easel, she wipes one fingertip on a cloth, then lifts a fine brush to turn the accidental mark into a leaf. Clear side-window light reveals pale hair, focused eyes, pigment and paper in one close studio portrait. No readable writing or additional artists.

blueprints.title: 椎名真白 · 雨中撑伞的猫步
blueprints.description: 放学小雨，她撑着伞沿着白线一步一步走猫步，积水溅起也不管；伞沿压得很低，只露出没有表情的半张脸，画面安静而奇妙。
blueprints.action: 压低雨伞，沿白线一步接一步地轻巧前行。
blueprints.promptProse: Under a low-held umbrella after school, Mashiro follows the white road marking with one careful step placed directly ahead of the other. A small splash rises beside her school shoes, unnoticed. Only the lower edge of her calm face peeks beneath the umbrella, with pale hair falling over her blazer; a nearby street-level view holds the rain, road line and quiet movement.

blueprints.title: 椎名真白 · 毕业展的白色展厅
blueprints.description: 个人画展的白色展厅，她穿着干净的连衣裙站在自己的巨幅画作前，双手背在身后；面对观众依旧是三无表情，但手指在背后悄悄握紧。

blueprints.promptProse: A huge painting hangs behind Mashiro in the white graduation-exhibition gallery. She turns slightly toward visitors outside the frame, fingers quietly clasped behind her ivory dress although her expression stays composed. Her pale orange eyes carry restrained anticipation. Soft gallery lighting separates cream-blonde hair from the white wall, leaving generous headroom in the medium portrait.
